name: SPEC_GENETIC_CONTRIBUTORS
description: The person that an egg or sperm came from. For embryos, this table stores the egg and sperm sources used to create the embryo.

columns.name: SPECIMEN_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the specimen record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: GEN_CONTRIB_NONPAT_RECORD_ID
columns.description: Non-patients who are genetic contributors to the specimen, i.e. have provided the sperm or egg. This will store external donors who don't have a chart in the system.

columns.name: PAT_ROLE_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores whether the genetic contributor for a specimen is the oocyte or sperm contributor.

columns.name: GAMETE_SOURCE_C_NAME
columns.description: The type of genetic contribution. This includes autologous, partner, anonymous donor, and directed donor.
